sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Settings with a fixed set of choices are now a row of buttons, one per choice, instead of a text box or a pair of checkboxes (needs VZ_MBLibrary 4.4.0). Click one, or use the arrow keys; the Default column names the default choice and the tooltip lists them all. Converted: "Expanded CAA/EAA cell layout" (Grid / Grouped / List), "Viewer: image background" (Dark / Light / Checker), "Viewer: move a zoomed image by", "Artwork viewer image size", and the small and big CAA/EAA image fetch sizes (250 / 500 / 1200 px, which used to accept any number and so could ask the archive for a size it does not have). Your current values are kept. A configuration file with a value that is none of the choices now has that value refused on 📂 Load, like a bad number.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The "Sidebar" cards (9.99.1352) now start with only the first information card open (Artist information, Release information, …); the others start closed and show ▶ before their title. Ctrl+Click (Cmd+Click) on any card's title opens or closes every card at once, following the one you clicked; a plain click still opens or closes just that card. Hovering a card's title shows what it holds, how many entries, and how it folds. Setting: "… cards that start open" (No card / Information card / Every card; default: Information card).
